job.title: Senior Data Analyst
job.pay_full: $102,000 – $163,000 a year base salary, plus equity and benefits

details.about: Toast builds technology that helps restaurants and local businesses run, sell more, engage customers and keep employees happy. Its Strategic Finance team informs company-wide decisions, and this Senior Data Analyst will be the main analytics partner to the Sales organization — looking at pipeline, bookings, rep productivity and plan attainment, and presenting a clear view to Director and VP-level leaders.
duties: Analyze what drives bookings, pipeline conversion, win rates and new business results against plan
Build and maintain pacing views showing whether Sales is on track, and explain gaps
Study why results vary between reps to inform coverage and enablement decisions
Support planning and target setting with productivity models and quota inputs
Size and measure sales incentives, discount patterns, pricing initiatives and market size (TAM)
Build scenario models and sensitivity analyses
Use SQL and BI tools to automate reporting, standardize core sales metrics and validate data integrity
Partner with Data and Analytics Engineering on data models and pipelines, using AI tools to speed up analysis and reporting
Present findings and recommendations to Director and VP-level stakeholders
needs: 5+ years in business intelligence, data analytics, strategic finance or sales analytics, or a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a quantitative field such as math, economics, finance, computer science or a physical science
Strong SQL and statistical data modelling skills (e.g. SQL, Python, R)
A track record building interactive dashboards in tools such as Hex, Looker, Tableau or Sigma
Experience with sales data and metrics such as pipeline, bookings, quota attainment, win rate and productivity
Strong business modelling: forecasting, scenario analysis and ROI analysis
Data engineering experience and the ability to navigate new data sources
Exceptional written and verbal communication, attention to detail and comfort in a matrix organization
nice: Experience supporting a Sales organization from Finance, Sales Operations or Sales Strategy
Experience in a SaaS, fintech, subscription or transaction-based business
Familiarity with recurring revenue metrics such as ARR
Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, dbt, Hex and AI tools
details.benefits: Base salary range $102,000 – $163,000; the starting salary depends on skills, experience and location. Total rewards also include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity and benefits.
notes: Toast works in a hybrid model; in-office expectations vary by region
Toast offers accommodations in the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
